description: Figure 3 presents a bar chart illustrating the results of an ablation study, specifically focusing on the performance of different components within a model. The horizontal axis displays the ablated model configurations, labeled “Base,” “w/o Spatial,” “w/o Temporal,” “w/o Audio,” “w/o Text,” and “w/o Visual,” with configurations listed in that order. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage (F1(%)), with a linear scale ranging from 70 to 90, incrementing by 5. Each configuration is represented by a single bar. The “Base” model bar is blue and reaches approximately 85.1%. The “w/o Spatial” bar is orange and extends to about 84.2%. The “w/o Temporal” bar is green and reaches approximately 83.6%. The “w/o Audio” bar is red and extends to about 83.1%. The “w/o Text” bar is purple and reaches approximately 82.4%. Finally, the “w/o Visual” bar is teal and extends to about 79.8%. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors, and are arranged sequentially as listed on the horizontal axis.
